name: NeuS Sampler
definition: A sampling method for Neural Surface SDF (NeuS) that uses a signed distance function network to generate samples. It iteratively upsamples by merging new PDF samples with existing ones, using a fixed variance parameter (inv_s) that scales with iteration count.
summary: NeuS Sampler is an iterative importance sampling method for Neural Surface SDFs that dynamically adjusts SDF-to-alpha conversion softness via a fixed variance parameter to ensure robust convergence.
